text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! My very cells are<n>burning with
energy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My power is growing stronger and<n>stronger! I feel
like a completely<n>different person to who I was just
a<n>few moments ago!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's as if I've evolved! Excellent!<n>Now I'm another
step closer to taking<n>on the world!
